# JIV — Journey In Vladivostok Full Context Dump
> Complete technical context, code schemas, and Data Adapter architecture definitions for LLM parsing.

## 1. Project Overview
- Name: Journey In Vladivostok (JIV)
- Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Express.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, Lucide React, Google GenAI SDK.
- Primary Port: 3000 (0.0.0.0)

## 2. Global Bridge Data Adapters Architecture
The project abstracts vessel listings behind `IVesselDataProvider`:

```typescript
export interface IVesselDataProvider {
  readonly providerId: VesselSourceType; // 'internal' | 'farpost' | 'yandex' | 'airbnb'
  readonly providerName: string;
  readonly sourceUrl: string;
  getVessels(filters?: VesselFilterOptions): Promise<Vessel[]>;
  getVesselById(id: string): Promise<Vessel | null>;
}
```

Registered Adapters:
1. `LocalDBProvider`: JIV Direct Fleet Registry (`src/lib/providers/LocalDBProvider.ts`).
2. `FarPostAdapter`: FarPost.ru Marine Feed (`src/lib/providers/FarPostAdapter.ts`).
3. `YandexTravelAdapter`: Yandex Travel & Yandex Go Sea Taxi (`src/lib/providers/YandexTravelAdapter.ts`).
4. `AirbnbLuxAdapter`: Airbnb Luxe Marine Charters (`src/lib/providers/AirbnbLuxAdapter.ts`).

Aggregated via `AggregateVesselProvider` (`globalVesselAggregator`).

## 3. Core Data Schemas (`src/types.ts`)

```typescript
export type VesselCategory = 'yacht' | 'boat' | 'jetski' | 'taxi' | 'catamaran';
export type VesselSourceType = 'internal' | 'farpost' | 'yandex' | 'airbnb';
export type SupportedCurrency = 'RUB' | 'USD' | 'CNY';

export interface Vessel {
  id: string;
  source_type: VesselSourceType;
  source_name: string;
  original_url: string;
  vessel_type: VesselCategory;
  geo_coordinates: { lat: number; lng: number };
  
  name: string;
  category: VesselCategory;
  description: string;
  capacity: number;
  speed: number;
  homeport: string;
  coordinates: { x: number; y: number };
  latLon: [number, number];
  priceHour?: number;
  priceDay?: number;
  currency?: SupportedCurrency;
  rating: number;
  reviewsCount: number;
  captainName: string;
  captainPhone: string;
  images: string[];
  features: string[];
  hasSharkRepeller?: boolean;
  hasEchoSounder?: boolean;
  allowedActivities?: string[];
  isLive?: boolean;
  responseTime?: number;
  partnerVerificationId?: string;
}
```

## 4. Multi-Region Realization Markets (`src/lib/regionConfig.ts`)
1. `ru-vladivostok`: Yandex Maps, NSPK/Mir, SBP, T-Pay, RUB currency.
2. `asia-hub`: Baidu Maps, WeChat Pay, Alipay, UnionPay, CNY currency.
3. `global-marina`: OpenSeaMap, Stripe, Apple Pay, PayPal, USD currency.

## 5. REST API Specification (`server.ts`)
- `GET /api/health`
- `GET /api/vessels?category=&source=&capacity=&maxPrice=&search=`
- `GET /api/vessels/:id`
- `GET /api/tours`
- `GET /api/rates`
- `GET /api/regions`
- `GET /api/openapi.json`
- `GET /api/docs`
